Building Code: a restaurant or bar is Assembly Group A-2, and a space for fewer than 50 people is Group B (2022 California Building Code).
basis.code_section: California Building Code 2022 edition, § 303.1.1, § 303.3; San Francisco Building Code § 106A.1.12

basis.text: The description does not give whether the space is for fewer than 50 people, so the proposed occupancy group is not established.
The existing occupancy group of the space is not in public records; only plans or an inspection show it. A change of occupancy is not established.

Without whether the space is for fewer than 50 people and the existing occupancy group of the space, which only plans or an inspection show, the rules cannot say whether this is a change of occupancy, so they cannot say which building permit applies: insufficient information.
basis.code_section: San Francisco Building Code § 106A.1; Planning Code § 175
